purpose: Teach: 沈ん/終っ/有っ/盗ん/図ら/造ら/生かさ/臨ん

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがソファに沈んでお休みになってるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's dozed off into the sofa. He must be worn out.
lines.style: Warm observation, slightly amused at the domestic sight. Quiet affection underneath. Speaking to Sho but also to herself, noticing how hard Ryosuke works.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが宿題のチェックを終ってくれたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad finished checking my homework for me.
lines.style: Bright pride in his voice. Speaking clearly, wanting Mom to hear the good news. Small excitement without being loud — genuine joy that Dad helped him.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが有ってこそお家が温かいわね
lines.en: You know, Sho — your dad being here is what makes this home feel warm.
lines.style: Tender realization, speaking slowly. Not directing it at Sho exactly, but allowing him to hear her appreciation. A moment of quiet gratitude.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、人の物を盗んだりしないって誓うよ
lines.en: Mom, I promise — I'll never steal from anyone.
lines.style: Serious, young voice making a solemn pledge. Speaking with gravity beyond his six years. A pause before the final word, like he's measuring its weight.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがぼくの予定を図ら考えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad thinks ahead about what you need. He takes care of it before you even ask.
lines.style: Quiet pride in how Ryosuke plans for him. Speaking with gentle awareness of something small but meaningful. Not sentimental — just noticing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんがお家を造らせて下さったって聞いたよ
lines.en: Mom, I heard Grandpa was the one who built our house for us.
lines.style: Thoughtful, taking in something bigger than himself. Speaking with a child's wonder at family legacy. A slight pause, as if understanding something new.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんの教えを生かさないとね
lines.en: We have to live by what Grandpa taught us, Sho. We can't let that go to waste.
lines.style: Quiet instruction, not commanding but clear. The weight of family responsibility — gentle but firm. Speaking as much to herself as to him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが試合に臨んで頑張ってらしたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad went to his game and gave it everything he had.
lines.style: Proud report, eyes bright. Describing something he witnessed and admired. Clear, direct voice — this is important to tell her.
